patterns.note: The homepage features a single, vertically scrolling column of oversized text, acting as a dynamic list of clients or projects, while interior pages utilize a clean, responsive grid for content display.
Extreme contrast in type scale is used, with primary content rendered in massive, bold, uppercase sans-serif, while navigation and secondary text are small and understated.
A stark monochrome palette of black text on a white background dominates the entire site, emphasizing typography and content with minimal visual distraction.

Header and footer navigation elements remain fixed at the top and bottom of the viewport respectively, while the main content scrolls continuously behind them without additional scroll-triggered animations.
The homepage is a continuous, single-section scroll of text, while interior pages are structured into clear, repeating grid sections for portfolio items.

technique_notes: To rebuild the motion, implement fixed-position header and footer elements that remain visible at all scroll depths. The main content area should be a standard scrollable container. While anime-js is detected, the primary scroll-triggered motion observed is the simple continuous scroll of content behind sticky navigation, suggesting anime-js might be used for subtle hover interactions or page transitions not visible in the scroll sequence.

The visual design relies on a high-contrast, minimalist aesthetic achieved through a strict black and white color scheme and the dramatic use of oversized, bold, uppercase typography as the primary visual element.
Portfolio pages utilize a clean, responsive grid layout for displaying project thumbnails, with clear labels below each image, maintaining a consistent visual hierarchy.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, bold, uppercase display text (approx. 5-8x body size) for primary content, contrasted with small, regular-weight sans-serif for navigation and secondary information.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp (all corners are 0px radius, contributing to a crisp, modern feel).
design_tokens.spacing: Airy vertical spacing between large text elements on the homepage, with a more balanced, tight grid spacing on portfolio pages.

standout: The site's distinctive design is its almost brutalist reliance on massive, bold, uppercase typography as the sole hero and primary content on the homepage, creating a powerful, direct, and highly memorable visual statement that eschews traditional imagery or complex layouts.
